verdict.rationale: Canny documents a first-party MCP server that users add to ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor with a secure sign-in. Agents can query feedback, themes, ARR impact and the roadmap, and can act on it by updating statuses, linking deals, replying to customers and sending conversations to Autopilot. A probe confirms the official MCP page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, and in-depth technical documentation such as an endpoint URL, tool reference, or auth/permission details beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Add Canny's MCP server to ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor with a secure sign-in. No API keys, no engineering.
Move ideas through your workflow without leaving your LLM. Update statuses, link deals, organize requests, and reply to customers.
run agents that act on feedback
official MCP server documented at https://canny.io/features/mcp
